title: Scale Model Car Koenigsegg CCX
what: A realistic 1:20 scale high-detail model of the Koenigsegg CCX, including painted interior components such as seats, dashboard, and steering wheel. Encased in an acrylic display box with an info plate.
why: Built as a gift for a previous manager and as a personal hobby project to explore surface modeling, gain experience with 3D printing, and learn model painting techniques.
how: Modified and prepared a 3D model in Blender, 3D printed all parts, then sanded, primed, and hand-painted using acrylic paints. Final assembly clear coated and enclosed in an acrylic case for presentation.
